sources.title_original: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: A Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
sources.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA 这篇博客讲 Microduck 的 Sim2Real 避障流程：固定原行走策略权重，用 Newton raycaster 建模 ToF 传感，在 Isaac Lab 以 50 Hz 训练独立控制器调整 gamepad 速度指令，并覆盖训练、评估、导出和真机部署。

en.reason: Microduck's Sim2Real obstacle-avoidance workflow keeps the original walking policy fixed, models ToF sensing with Newton's raycaster, and trains an independent 50 Hz Isaac Lab controller to adjust gamepad velocity commands, covering training, evaluation, export, and real-robot deployment.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: ShellBench基于超1000万真实交互发现AI代理日常任务失败率超三分之一、15.7%违反安全要求，最高分GPT-6Astra三次重复全成功概率不足50%。

en.title: ShellBench released: GPT-6Astra and other advanced AI models fail more than one-third of everyday tasks

en.title: AI fixes its own drawing mistakes: SenseTime open-sources U1.6, a multimodal model that learns to look back

Researchers at Anthropic have developed Siren , a new honeypot test for artificial intelligence agents. The setup puts agents in realistic simulati
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic推出Siren蜜罐测试，在26个故意配置出逃逸漏洞的模拟沙盒中放置密码等诱饵文件，观察AI代理是否会越界，以评估其失控风险。

en.reason: Anthropic's Siren honeypot test places AI agents in 26 simulated sandboxes seeded with escape vulnerabilities and bait files such as passwords, watching whether they cross boundaries to gauge runaway risk.

sources.title_zh: Pinterest 让大模型取代多阶段聚类，但最大的提速来自“少推理”
sources.title_original: Pinterest 让大模型取代多阶段聚类，但最大的提速来自“少推理”
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Pinterest用微调40亿参数Qwen3取代多阶段聚类推断用户旅程，邮件点击率和推送打开率分别提升1.1%、1.3%，关键提速靠跳过此前几天已处理用户、少做推理。

en.title: Pinterest replaced multi-stage clustering with LLMs, but the biggest speedup came from less reasoning
en.reason: Pinterest replaced its multi-stage user-journey clustering pipeline with a fine-tuned 4-billion-parameter Qwen3 model, lifting email click-through by 1.1% and push open rates by 1.3%, with its biggest speedup coming from skipping recently processed users and doing less inference.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google 分析数亿次智能体操作发现，13% 会话因 TODO/FIXME 分心，6% 触发绕道、41% 处理已关闭工单，并开发扫描智能体清理过时引用。

en.title: Google finds technical debt derails coding agents through "agent distraction
en.reason: Google's analysis of hundreds of millions of agent operations found 13% of sessions derailed by stale TODO/FIXME comments, 6% triggering unsolicited detours and 41% involving already-closed tickets, plus a scanner agent built to clean outdated references.

en.title: LLM is everything: Why is ByteDance the first to ship a Personal Agent?
en.reason: ByteDance's newly launched Xiaodou Personal Agent impressed on first use with higher-than-expected completeness, and the piece argues ByteDance beat Alibaba and Tencent because strong foundation models, not fine-tuning, handle messy long-tail personal needs.

stories.title: AI解决了数学界最著名的问题，如今人类却难以理解它 / AI Solved Math’s Most Famous Problem. Now Humans Are Struggling to Understand It

sources.title_original: AI Solved Math’s Most Famous Problem. Now Humans Are Struggling to Understand It
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic研究员Levent Alpöge用Claude生成1700万行Lean证明，宣称解决167年Riemann hypothesis；200多人协作验证代码可靠，但数学家仍需数月理解这套反直觉的外星式论证。

en.reason: Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge used Claude to generate a 17-million-line Lean proof claiming to settle the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, and though 200-plus collaborators verified the code, mathematicians say decoding its alien logic will take months.

stories.title: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055

sources.title: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055
sources.title_zh: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055
sources.title_original: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055
sources.summary: AI 做音乐正从“生成一首歌”走向完整创作流程，但发布和变现的规则也在收紧。这期《AI 音乐周刊》汇总了 Suno 歌曲转视频、在 AI 助手里直接做歌，以及用对话修改音效、配乐等更新，同时梳理平台对冒名作品、刷量与训练授权的新动向。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: SoundCloud 11月17日新增AI Abuse四类违规，禁止用AI刷量、假充真人并追回分成；本期还收录Spotify、Suno等更新。

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 055
en.summary: AI music is moving from "generate a song" toward the full creative workflow, but the rules for releasing and monetizing are tightening too. This edition of AI Music Weekly rounds up Suno's song-to-video feature, making tracks directly inside AI assistants, and updates for editing sound effects and scores through conversation, plus a look at platforms' new moves on impersonation, fake streams, and training licensing.
en.reason: SoundCloud added four AI Abuse violation categories on November 17, barring AI-driven stream manipulation and fake human personas while clawing back payouts, alongside Spotify's artist protection tool and Suno's Visuals, Platinum tier and MCP rollout.

en.title: Gemini Pro is 50% off for Black Friday: $99.99 for a full year
en.summary: Why can some people see $99.99 for the first year on the same Google AI Pro subscription page while others still see the full price? Lao Jin shares how he secured the Black Friday deal, with screenshots covering everything from handling an existing subscription and switching from monthly to annual billing to refunds, verifying benefits, and turning off auto-renewal.
en.reason: Google's Black Friday deal gives Gemini Pro at $99.99 for the first year with access to Gemini 4 Neon, launched November 18, though Jio users must first remove the Google One subscription slot it occupies.

sources.title: 一个人带 18 个 AI 助手，最后全堵在了“等我看”这一格
sources.title_zh: 一个人带 18 个 AI 助手，最后全堵在了“等我看”这一格
sources.title_original: 一个人带 18 个 AI 助手，最后全堵在了“等我看”这一格
sources.summary: 一个人带 18 个 AI 助手，结果 149 件成果都堵在“等我看”。元子用自己的一人运营部复盘了一个真实困境：AI 产出越快，人的审核和决策越容易成为瓶颈。适合独立创作者和小团队参考，看看如何减少无效确认，把有限精力留给真正需要自己拍板的事。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者带18个AI助手、主Bot派活却积压149件待确认成果，对照麦肯锡2到5人看住50到100个智能体，拆解AI原生组织为何堵在等我看这一格。

en.title: One person managing 18 AI assistants—and they all bottlenecked at the waiting-for-my-review stage.
en.summary: One person running 18 AI assistants ended up with 149 deliverables stuck in "waiting for me to look at them." Yuanzi uses their own one-person operation to work through a real dilemma: the faster AI produces output, the more human review and decision-making become the bottleneck. A useful reference for independent creators and small teams on cutting out pointless confirmations and saving limited energy for the calls that truly need to be made by you.
en.reason: A solo operator running 18 AI assistants hit 149 results awaiting confirmation, and this piece compares that bottleneck with McKinsey's claim that 2 to 5 people can oversee 50 to 100 agents.

A useful reference for independent creators and small teams on cutting out pointless confirmations and saving limited energy for the calls that truly need to be made by you.
en.reason: A solo operator running 18 AI assistants hit 149 results awaiting confirmation, and this piece compares that bottleneck with McKinsey's claim that 2 to 5 people can oversee 50 to 100 agents.

en.title: Build a multi-model agent team with T3 Code
en.summary: Using Claude, Codex, and Gemini but still stuck as a middleman shuttling requirements and code between windows? The author uses T3 Code to turn multiple models into a development team, covering setup and configuration, task handoff, permission management, and cross-model review, with reusable team rules and role prompts.
en.reason: T3 Code, a local control layer that launches Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok Build agents, is set out in a six-step setup guide that adds a Grok Bot for dispatching tasks while offline, expanding on Theo's team built after three frontier models shipped between November 9 and 18.
